message:
The vulnerability is a heap-buffer-overflow WRITE in `decode_chars`, called from `decode_font`, called from `process_text`. This is in libass's font decoding code. Let me look at the relevant source files.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libass && grep -n "decode_chars\|decode_font\|process_text" libass/*.c libass/*.h 2>/dev/null | head -40</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
